facts.claim: Seabourn Encore (Seabourn): Entered service 2016; 40,350 GT; 600 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 210 m length; Encore class.
MV Seabourn Encore is a luxury cruise ship built by Fincantieri of Italy for Seabourn Cruise Line.
The first of a new class of ships about 26% larger than Seabourn's three Odyssey-class vessels, she holds about 34% more passengers, based on double occupancy.
Sister ship of MV Seabourn Ovation.

catalogSpecs.description: Operated by Seabourn; entered service 2016; 40,350 GT; approx. 600 guests at double occupancy.
